calls.statement:
WITH wd AS (
  SELECT web_order_id, member_key AS order_member_key, login_state, status,
         CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
  FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered','collected')
),
l AS (
  SELECT d.fiscal_period, f.sales_line_id, f.receipt_id, f.line_no, f.net_amount, f.member_key, w.order_member_key, w.login_state, s.store_id, s.region, p.category
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN wd w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
  JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = w.dispatch_date
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 35 AND 47
)
SELECT fiscal_period, store_id, region,
  count(*) AS lines, count(DISTINCT sales_line_id) AS dist_lines, count(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) AS dist_rl,
  sum(CASE WHEN category='ZZ Test' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS test_lines,
  sum(net_amount) AS net_all,
  sum(CASE WHEN member_key IS NOT NULL THEN net_amount ELSE 0 END) AS net_member_line,
  sum(CASE WHEN order_member_key IS NOT NULL THEN net_amount ELSE 0 END) AS net_member_order,
  sum(CASE WHEN login_state='logged_in' THEN net_amount ELSE 0 END) AS net_loggedin,
  sum(CASE WHEN login_state='logged_in' AND member_key IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS loggedin_nomember_lines,
  sum(CASE WHEN login_state='guest' AND member_key IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS guest_member_lines
FROM l GROUP BY 1,2,3 ORDER BY 1,2;

calls.statement:
SELECT d.fiscal_period, d.fiscal_week,
  count(*) AS lines,
  sum(CASE WHEN o.login_state='logged_in' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS loggedin_lines,
  sum(CASE WHEN o.login_state='logged_in' AND f.member_key IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS loggedin_line_null,
  sum(CASE WHEN o.member_key IS NOT NULL AND m.member_key IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS order_key_not_in_dim,
  sum(CASE WHEN o.login_state='logged_in' AND f.member_key IS NOT NULL AND f.member_key<>o.member_key THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS key_mismatch,
  sum(CASE WHEN o.login_state='guest' AND o.member_key IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS guest_with_key
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', o.dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE)
LEFT JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key=o.member_key
WHERE o.status IN ('delivered','collected') AND d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 33 AND 49
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2;

WITH web_dispatch AS (
  SELECT web_order_id, member_key AS order_member_key,
         CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
  FROM fact_web_order
  WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
web_lines AS (
  SELECT w.dispatch_date, w.order_member_key, f.net_amount
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
  WHERE s.store_id = 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN l.order_member_key IS NOT NULL THEN l.net_amount ELSE 0 END) / SUM(l.net_amount), 1) AS member_share_of_web_sales_pct
FROM web_lines l
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = l.dispatch_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 9 AND 11
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1, 2;
